title: Transport Tycoon 2014 Soundtrack (remaster with real instrument from original creator)
summary: A complete remastered soundtrack for the Transport Tycoon 2014 mobile game, re-recorded with real instruments rather than the original MIDI. The music was composed by John Broomhall for the classic Transport Tycoon.
why: Fans of Transport Tycoon and OpenTTD point to it as a nostalgic, live-instrument version of the game's music.

quote.text: The composer performed it with real instruments sometime in the past few years and it really brought on those nostalgic feelings
